name: rendley
description: Create and edit Rendley video projects, work with media, and export finished videos from chat.

interface.longDescription:
Create and edit videos with prompts. Rendley can use your footage, files, links, and other context to cut clips, repurpose content, resize videos for different formats, add captions, or create something entirely new.

Rendley's editing agent watches your footage, decides the cut, and builds the video on an editable timeline, with your brand kit, titles, music, and voiceover. It can also generate the images, clips, music, and voiceovers you're missing, and show you its plan before it changes anything.

Every change is saved to your Rendley project. Open it in the editor at any time to watch the edit happen or fine-tune anything you want, then export the finished video.
capabilities: Generate images, video, music, and voiceovers
Open your projects in the Rendley editor
defaultPrompt: Turn my latest recording into a 30-second vertical highlight with captions
Remove the filler words and long pauses from my interview
Resize my video for Instagram Reels and keep the speaker in frame

review.commerce_description: The plugin does not sell products, create subscriptions, or process purchases. Users connect an existing Rendley account; some actions require existing entitlements or consume existing credits. A feature outside the account's entitlement is reported as unavailable without initiating or promoting a purchase or upgrade.

positive.expected_behavior: Captions that match the speech are added to the video, and the reply links to the project in the Rendley editor.

positive.description: Remove filler words and awkward pauses from my video.
positive.prompt: Remove filler words and awkward pauses from my video
positive.expected_behavior: Long pauses and any filler words are cut, the video gets shorter, and the reply says what was removed (or that no filler words were found) and links to the editor.

positive.description: Resize my video for Instagram Reels.
positive.prompt: Resize my video for Instagram Reels
positive.expected_behavior: The video becomes vertical (1080 x 1920) with the speaker kept in frame, and the reply links to the editor.

positive.description: Add stock B-roll that matches what I'm saying.
positive.prompt: Add stock B-roll that matches what I'm saying.
positive.expected_behavior: Rendley lists the stock shots it plans to add and asks for approval first; a step that costs credits, such as checking each clip against the narration, is asked about separately and can be declined. Stock clips that match what is being said are then placed over the video, the speaker's audio keeps playing, and the reply links to the editor.
An MP4 export runs, and once it has finished the reply gives the download link.

publication.release_notes: Rendley's editing agent now works in ChatGPT. Describe the video you want and it watches your footage, decides the cut, and builds it on an editable timeline: captions, highlights, filler words and pauses removed, Shorts and Reels formats, your brand kit, titles, music, and voiceover. It can generate the images, clips, music, and voiceovers you're missing, shows you its plan before it changes anything, and saves every change to your Rendley project, ready to fine-tune in the editor or export.
